profile.summary: The Department of Violence Prevention is a City of Oakland agency created in 2017. It uses a public health approach to violence prevention. It supervises staff who provide life coaching and violence interruption, funds community organizations that provide violence intervention and healing services, and helps build the capacity of those organizations.
